datenschutz.intro: Privacy policy in accordance with GDPR and German BDSG.

sections.p:
The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
Freie Evangeliums-Christen-Gemeinde Dresden e.V., Altenberger Strasse 87, 01279 Dresden, Deutschland.
E-mail: kontakt@freieevangeliums-dresden.de · Phone: +49 159 05316414

We process personal data only insofar as it is necessary to provide a functional website. The legal basis is regularly your consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR) or a statutory permission (Art. 6 (1) (b), (c), (f) GDPR).

This website is hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH, Industriestr. 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany. Servers are located in Germany. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. A data processing agreement (DPA) under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with Hetzner.

The hosting provider automatically collects information in server log files (browser type, OS, referrer, hostname, time, IP address). This data is not merged with other sources. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

Non-essential cookies are only set with your explicit consent through our consent banner (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR, § 25 (1) TDDDG). Technically necessary cookies (language, consent storage) are used pursuant to § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG. You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.
If you contact us, the data you provide will be stored to process your request. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (b) or (f) GDPR. No data is passed on to third parties.

sections.h: 6. Photo and video recordings at church events
sections.p:
As part of our church work, we occasionally take photos and videos of services and events in order to report on church life on our website.

Legal basis: The processing of recordings in which individual persons are clearly the focus (e.g. portraits) takes place exclusively on the basis of your express consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. Recordings of overviews, groups and general events in the context of church life are based on our legitimate interest in public relations pursuant to Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Storage period: The photos remain published on the website for as long as is necessary for the purpose of informing about church life, or until consent is revoked or a legitimate objection is made.

Right of revocation and objection: You have the right to revoke consent to the publication of a photo at any time with effect for the future. You may also object to processing based on legitimate interest at any time for reasons arising from your particular situation. To do so, simply contact us using the contact details given in section 1. The affected recordings will then be removed without delay.

sections.h: 7. Provision of sermons in MP3 format (audio)
sections.p:
On our website we make recorded sermons available as audio files in MP3 format.

Hosting on own servers: The MP3 files are stored locally on our own server structures (hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH, Germany). No IP addresses or other user data are passed on to third-party providers (such as YouTube, Spotify or SoundCloud).

Legal basis: The processing of the preachers' data (name, voice, content of the sermon) takes place exclusively on the basis of their express consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. If individual voices or spoken contributions of service participants can be heard in the background of recordings, this processing takes place within the scope of our legitimate interest in documenting and disseminating church life pursuant to Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Right of revocation: The preachers have the right to revoke their consent to making the recordings available on the Internet at any time with effect for the future. In this case the files will be deleted from our servers without delay.
Our "Find Us" page embeds maps from OpenStreetMap (OSMF, Cambridge, UK). When you load the page, technical data (incl. IP address) is transmitted to OSMF. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
We use Bunny Fonts (EU provider) as a privacy-friendly alternative to Google Fonts. No user profiling takes place.

You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21), as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority (Saxon Data Protection Commissioner), Devrientstraße 1, 01067 Dresden.
You have the right, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to object at any time to the processing of personal data concerning you.
For security reasons this site uses SSL/TLS encryption.
We reserve the right to amend this declaration to ensure it always meets current legal requirements.

confession.intro: We are Evangelical Christian Baptists who believe the Bible is the sole authority in matters of faith and life.
items: The Bible is the Word of God — inspired, infallible and authoritative.
We believe in one God, eternally existing in three Persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Salvation is by faith alone in Jesus Christ, who died and rose again for our redemption.
Baptism is performed by immersion for those who have consciously accepted Christ.
Celebrated regularly in remembrance of Christ's sacrifice.
We await the literal, personal return of Jesus Christ.
confession.quote: "For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life."
solaItems: The believer is saved by God's grace alone, not by works.
Justification comes through faith alone – through trust in God.
The Bible alone, as the Word of God, is the foundation of Christian faith.
Only the person, work and teaching of Jesus Christ can be the ground of faith and salvation.
confession.rechenschaftBody: As Freie Evangeliums-Christen-Gemeinde Dresden e.V. we share the “Rechenschaft vom Glauben” – the joint confession of faith of German-speaking Baptists. It was drafted between 1974 and 1977 by theologians from the BEFG (West and East), Austria and Switzerland and expresses the common convictions of our movement. For us the Bible is the sole foundation of faith; the confession is not meant to impose binding doctrine but to make our shared convictions visible.
baptistenItems: … are called by God to freedom and follow Jesus in responsibility before God and their own conscience.
… as believers in Jesus Christ are directly connected to God and equal to one another. In their community all ministries, offices and functions are of equal value and open to all.
… stand up for freedom of faith, conscience and religious practice and for the separation of church and state.
… celebrate God's love for humanity and reconciliation with God and baptise people who confess their faith in Jesus Christ of their own free will.
… as a community of believers take part in God's work in the world by bearing witness to His goodness and standing up for justice.
… understand the Bible as God's Word in human words and orient their faith and life solely by it.
… organise locally in independent congregations and connect regionally and worldwide.
confession.principlesNote: (based on the “Baptist Principles” and the formulation of the working group Kirche 21 of the GJW)
